purpose: Targeted final Rust integration verification of newly included supervisor/watchdog diagnostic logs.

source_scope.production_change: Add supervisors and connectivity-watchdog to the fixed list of diagnostic log tails; two production lines added.
source_scope.test_change: Add fixture logs, section/message assertions and a supervisor Authorization-header secret canary; eleven integration-test lines added.

environment.fixtures: Synthetic temporary module directories; no private subscription or Android device.

review.result: No introduced privacy or size-budget regression found in this delta.
privacy: Both fixed log names use log_tail -> Collector.append -> Privacy.line; neither uses append_safe or emits raw source lines directly.

The shared filter strips controls, redacts credential headers including multiword values, masks configuration-derived private strings and node labels, suppresses UID/comment values, then applies the common token redactor.
The integration fixture verifies both new section headings and useful failure messages while rejecting the supervisor Authorization-header canary.
Existing log path handling requires containment in the canonical module directory and a regular non-symlink leaf file opened with O_NONBLOCK and O_NOFOLLOW.
budget_and_effects: Each new log uses the same bounded input window and retained-line cap as existing logs; no additional subprocess or external network probe is introduced.
Both sections use the existing section/report truncation path. Export still rejects an oversized completed report before creating an output file.
The monotonic remaining-time calculation still applies to every diagnostic subprocess. Additional local file reads do not reset or enlarge this budget.
Observation does not reconcile canonical state. Export publishes the existing single private report path; existing atomic replacement and failed-publication cleanup code is unchanged.

scope_limits: These are targeted tests for the two-log addition, not a repeat of the full workspace suite, executable differential suite or performance measurements.

The previously completed full workspace verification at d58dbdc covered 801 passing unit tests, 64 passing integration tests and one pre-existing ignored stress test. These 13 targeted passes are a subset, not 13 additional unique tests.
The 25-second constant limits subprocess collection using remaining monotonic time; it is not a hard deadline for all filesystem I/O, redaction CPU work or final persistence.
The 32 KiB log bound describes input bytes read. UTF-8 replacement and diagnostic metadata can expand rendered text; section/report guards constrain publication.
Synthetic canary checks and source review do not establish complete redaction for every possible arbitrary log format.
No real Android export, external-storage permission behavior, service restart, private configuration or outbound connectivity was exercised.
